title: What Is Artificial Intelligence?
introduction: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the idea that machines can do tasks that usually need human thinking. Knowing what AI is helps us see how technology works in our daily lives.

sections.heading: Defining Artificial Intelligence
paragraphs: Artificial Intelligence is a field of computer science that aims to create machines that can perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as recognizing speech or making decisions.
In simple terms, AI tries to give computers the ability to think, learn, and solve problems like a person would.

example.title: AI in a smartphone
example.content: When your phone suggests the next word while you type, it uses AI to predict what you might want to write.

sections.heading: Why AI Is Called Intelligence
paragraphs: AI is called intelligence because it can process information, learn from experience, and make choices without being explicitly programmed for each situation.
This ability to adapt and improve over time is similar to how humans learn from practice and feedback.

example.title: Voice assistant understanding commands
example.content: Siri or Google Assistant listens to your voice, interprets the request, and replies, showing a form of machine intelligence.

sections.heading: AI vs. Traditional Software
sections.subheading: Key differences in how they work
paragraphs: Traditional software follows fixed rules written by programmers. It does exactly what the code tells it to do, no more, no less.
AI, on the other hand, can learn patterns from data and change its behavior, allowing it to handle new situations it was not directly programmed for.

example.title: Spam filter comparison
example.content: A rule‑based filter blocks emails containing certain words, while an AI spam filter learns from many emails to spot new spam patterns automatically.

sections.heading: Everyday Examples of AI
sections.subheading: AI you see in daily life
paragraphs: AI appears in many common tools, such as recommendation engines that suggest movies or products based on your past choices.
It also powers features like photo tagging, navigation route optimization, and language translation, making everyday tasks easier.

example.title: Recommendation systems
example.content: Netflix suggests movies based on what you have watched before, using AI to find patterns and predict what you might like next.

practice.title: Identify AI around you
practice.instruction: Look around your home or phone and write down three things that use AI, such as a voice assistant, photo tagging, or navigation suggestions.

keyTakeaways: AI means machines can perform tasks that normally need human intelligence.
AI differs from regular software because it can learn and improve from data.
Simple AI examples include voice assistants, predictive text, and recommendation systems.
